verdict.rationale: Pendo is a product analytics and in-app guidance platform with automation-adjacent features such as guides, segments, Leo-built actions and alerts, so versioning and rollback is a fair question. The evidence pack never documents version history, change review, or rollback for any automation, guide, or workflow. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
